name: Syrian Observatory for Human Rights (SOHR)
desc: UK-based monitor documenting casualties, airstrikes and ground fighting across Syria via in-country network.

name: Syrian Network for Human Rights (SNHR)
desc: UK-registered group documenting civilian deaths, detentions and violations in Syria; UN OHCHR data source.

name: Airwars
desc: Open-source civilian-harm archive tracking airstrikes across Gaza, Syria, Iraq, Yemen and more.

name: Yemen Data Project
desc: Independent dataset on air raids and strikes in Yemen, including coalition, US and Israeli operations.

name: ACLED Middle East Conflict Monitor
desc: ACLED real-time event dataset and interactive map of political violence across the Middle East.

name: Bellingcat (Middle East)
desc: Open-source investigative collective producing geolocated, verified Middle East conflict investigations.

name: Syria Civil Defence (White Helmets)
desc: Syrian rescue organisation reporting strikes, casualties and field response; merged into govt body in 2025.

name: Times of Israel Liveblog
desc: Rolling live coverage of Israel, Gaza, Iran and regional war developments updated continuously.

name: Al-Monitor
desc: DC-based independent outlet with country desks for Iran, Iraq, Israel, Lebanon, Syria and the Gulf.

name: Aurora Intel
desc: OSINT team posting real-time Middle East military and security developments with a regional focus.

name: The Intel Crab
desc: OSINT analyst geolocating and verifying conflict imagery across Middle East and global hotspots.

name: Institute for the Study of War (ISW)
desc: DC think tank publishing daily campaign assessments and control-of-terrain maps for regional conflicts.

name: Critical Threats Project (AEI) — Iran Updates
desc: AEI/ISW daily open-source analysis of Iran and its Axis of Resistance across the region.

name: FDD's Long War Journal
desc: FDD project reporting on jihadist groups, HTS, al-Qaeda, ISIS and state conflict across the region.

name: MEMRI
desc: Translates and analyses Arabic, Farsi, Turkish and other regional media on conflict and militancy.

name: Iran International
desc: London-based multilingual outlet covering Iran politics, military and the Iran-Israel conflict.

name: International Crisis Group — MENA
desc: Field-based conflict research and early-warning analysis across MENA crises and flashpoints.

name: Carnegie Middle East Center
desc: Beirut-based Carnegie center with on-the-ground research and the Sada journal on Arab affairs.

name: Iraq Body Count
desc: Largest public database of violent civilian deaths in Iraq since the 2003 invasion.

name: Al Jazeera — Middle East
desc: Continuous liveblogs and reporting on Gaza, Israel, Iran, Yemen and regional escalation.

name: Middle East Eye
desc: London-based outlet with live blogs and on-the-ground reporting across MENA conflicts.

name: Tehran Times
desc: Iranian English-language daily offering the official Tehran perspective on the conflict and region.
